Query results

Source: R/result.R
zuslothdb_result.Rd

DBI::dbSendQuery() runs a query and returns a zuslothdb_result, from which DBI::dbFetch() returns rows as a data frame; DBI::dbGetQuery() does both at once. The whole result is computed when the query runs (design D8); dbFetch(res, n) hands it over n rows at a time.

Usage

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbSendQuery(conn, statement, ..., params = NULL, immediate = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_connection,character'
dbSendStatement(conn, statement, ..., params = NULL, immediate = NULL)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbFetch(res, n = -1, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbClearResult(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbIsValid(dbObj, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbHasCompleted(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbGetRowCount(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbGetRowsAffected(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbGetStatement(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbColumnInfo(res, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
dbBind(res, params, ...)

# S4 method for class 'zuslothdb_result'
show(object)

Arguments

conn

A zuslothdb_connection.

statement

A single SQL string.

...

Not used.

params

Not supported: SlothDB has no prepared statements, so a non-NULL value is a zuslothdb_unsupported error.

immediate

Ignored: every statement runs at once.

res, dbObj, object

A zuslothdb_result.

n

The number of rows to fetch: a whole number from 0, or -1 or Inf for all that are left.

Value

dbSendQuery() and dbSendStatement(): a zuslothdb_result. dbFetch(): a data frame. The rest as in DBI.

Details

Columns arrive as these R types:

SlothDBR
BOOLEANlogical
TINYINT, SMALLINT, INTEGER, UTINYINT, USMALLINTinteger
BIGINT, UINTEGER, UBIGINTdouble, integer64 or character, by bigint
FLOAT, DOUBLEdouble
VARCHARcharacter, marked UTF-8

A value R cannot hold as asked is a zuslothdb_type_error naming the column and the row, never a silent change: a 64-bit integer beyond 2^53 with bigint = "numeric", an INTEGER of -2^31 (R's NA), or a string that is not valid UTF-8 or holds a NUL. Other types arrive in a later version; reading one is a zuslothdb_type_error.

A connection has one open result: sending another query clears the first, with a warning.

Examples

con <- DBI::dbConnect(zuslothdb())
res <- DBI::dbSendQuery(con, "SELECT 1 AS a, 'x' AS b")
DBI::dbFetch(res)
#>   a b
#> 1 1 x
DBI::dbClearResult(res)
DBI::dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT 42 AS answer")
#>   answer
#> 1     42
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
